title: A1 identity, action contract and fault baseline
featureClaim: baseline-only; long-session runtime remains unaccepted until later nodes

environment.buildIdentity: source/typecheck candidate; no Electron/Gateway build was used for A1 behavioral claims

commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/workspace-session.test.ts tests/unit/chat-session-continuity.test.ts tests/unit/handoff-depth.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

acceptance.criterion: Distinguish Workspace, Project projection, Assistant, SessionKey, physical sessionId, native thread, Turn/Run/Task and resource owner without a second Project or task owner.
Give every lifecycle action a visible behavior, inheritance boundary, prerequisites, failure/unknown state, recovery path and current source entry.

Fix an isolated-agent negative matrix for active archive, duplicate/late completion, generation changes, backend switch, authorization revocation, cross-workspace and restart; leave unexecuted items unmeasured.
Pin candidate, inputs, metric definition and future acceptance budget; generate a fresh current receipt rather than reusing old PASS/sample evidence.

rawRun.readback: Commands, logs and candidate identity were read from disk after the clean-candidate run.

deferredGaps.summary: Active archive still bypasses the canonical runtime lifecycle fence.
Restore has a crash window before the transcript rename.

unmeasured: live backend switch and actual-native-thread continuity
permission revocation across admission and follow-up
duplicate/late completion continuation against a running Gateway
restart with an unknown delete receipt
long-running resource and paired D2 quality/cost measurement

cleanup.notes: No long-running process or browser was launched; only source checks, deterministic tests, typecheck and comms replay artifacts.

limitations: A1 is a baseline and contract node, not a functioning long-session acceptance result.
CodeGraph is retired in the current repository; direct source search and caller inspection were used, and historic CodeGraph indexes were not treated as current authority.
No real-human evidence is claimed; every result is agent-driven.
No product lock, default, publication boundary, independent Project or second scheduler was changed.
